horizon.no_resources.title: No prepared game files
horizon.no_resources.prepare: Prepare them with horizon-prepare --prepare, or pass --resources <folder>.
horizon.get_the_game.title: Start OffHorizon from the launcher
horizon.get_the_game.about: This is the game the OffHorizon launcher installs and starts. On its own it has none of Minecraft's files, so it can't start.
horizon.get_the_game.minecraft: OffHorizon needs your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. The launcher signs you in and prepares the game files from it.
horizon.get_the_game.download: Download the launcher at %s, then press Play there.
horizon.extras.pregen.tooltip: Enables /pregen in your single-player and LAN worlds. With cheats enabled, use /pregen start to generate an area before exploring it. Does not enable the command on servers you join.
horizon.options.radial_mode.about: Hold the opener for the radial menu, or press it once to open it and again to close it.
horizon.options.radial_mode.hold.about: Hold the opener and let go to run what the stick points at.
horizon.options.radial_mode.toggle.about: Press the opener to open it; A or the opener again runs what the stick points at, B closes it.
horizon.options.radial_stick.about: The stick that points at the radial menu's slots.
horizon.options.radial_stick.right.about: The right stick points at the slots; the left still walks.
horizon.options.radial_stick.left.about: The left stick points and you stand still. D-pad Right is under that thumb: pick an opener on the Radial Menu page.
horizon.options.radial_stick.either.abou: The last stick pushed points; neither walks nor turns the view. Only a bumper, a trigger or View can open the menu.
horizon.options.unavailable: Ova funkcija još nije dostupna u OffHorizon-u.
horizon.studio.record.status.active: Studio recording active — %s s, %s packets, %s KB (%s)
horizon.studio.replay.seeked: Studio replay seeked to %s ms (%s s)
horizon.studio.replay.seek.backward_requ: Rewind is only available for a standalone replay.
horizon.studio.replay.status: Studio replay: %s / %s ms (%s%%), speed %s×, paused %s, finished %s
horizon.studio.freecam.enabled: Studio free camera enabled. Use WASD to move, Space and Shift to rise or descend, and Control to move faster.
horizon.studio.freecam.unavailable: Studio free camera could not find a player camera
horizon.studio.freecam.replay_required: Studio free camera is available during replay playback
horizon.studio.keyframe.added: Camera keyframe added at %s ms. The path is saved when you close the replay.
horizon.studio.keyframe.cleared: Camera path cleared. The change is saved when you close the replay.
horizon.studio.keyframe.removed: Removed camera keyframe %s. The change is saved when you close the replay.
horizon.studio.keyframe.index_invalid: Camera keyframe index is out of range
horizon.studio.path.usage: Usage: /studio path <lock|unlock> (add at least one keyframe first)
horizon.radial.why.quick_actions: This server has no Quick Actions
horizon.radial.pick.about: Puts this action in the slot and goes back. The slot's own is marked.
horizon.radial.missing.about: This game doesn't know the action %s: the slot keeps it and runs nothing. Press or Right to put another here.
horizon.radial.page_of: Page %s of %s. Each slot is a direction of the selecting stick while the opener is held.
horizon.radial.slot.about: The action this direction runs. Press it for the list of actions, Right for the next one, Left or Shift-click for the one before.
horizon.radial.rename.about: Give this page a name of your own.
horizon.radial.new_page.about: Adds an empty page after the last one, and shows it.
horizon.radial.new_page.full: The menu holds at most %s pages.
horizon.radial.delete_page.about: Removes this page and its slots at once. Undo brings it back.
horizon.radial.delete_page.last: The menu keeps at least one page.
horizon.radial.reset.about: Puts back the General and Camera pages and removes the rest, at once. Undo brings them back.
horizon.radial.reset.default: The pages are the defaults already.
horizon.radial.opener.about: The button held to open the menu. Press, then press the controller button to use: a bumper or the D-pad, not A, B, X, Y or the right stick, which steer and cancel.
horizon.radial.opener.about.left: The button held to open the menu. Press, then press the controller button to use: a bumper, A, X or Y, not the D-pad or the left stick, which steer, nor B, which cancels.
horizon.radial.opener.about.either: The button held to open the menu. Press, then press the controller button to use: a bumper, a trigger or View; both thumbs steer, and B cancels.
horizon.radial.unbound: No button opens the menu (one under the thumb that selects is let go): press, then press a controller button.
horizon.radial.conflict: Shared with another action: in play the menu takes that button. Press to pick another.
Named pages of eight actions, held open: Named pages of eight actions, held open with a button.
horizon.pages.music.empty: Nema muzičkih numera: zvuci igre se ne učitavaju.
horizon.pages.music.tooltip: Ugrađene numere, po situaciji: igrajte jednu sada ili isključite bilo koju da bi igra prestala da je bira.

horizon.pages.studio.tooltip: Browse saved recordings and their metadata.
horizon.pages.graphics.tooltip: Grafika, jednostavno: svako podešavanje govori koliko košta.
horizon.pages.graphics_advanced.tooltip: Sva grafička podešavanja, uključujući OffHorizon-ova, sa cenom svakog.
horizon.pages.controller.tooltip: Kontroleri: njihova dugmad, štapići, vibracije i navigacija u meniju.
horizon.pages.extras.tooltip: Opcioni dodaci, svi su podrazumevano isključeni: igra ostaje vanila dok je ne uključite.
horizon.pages.agent.tooltip: Neka vaš AI agent igra: horizon-ctl i MCP klijente na ovom računaru.
horizon.pages.split_profiles.tooltip: Ko igra: profil koji se čuva u ovoj fascikli igre.
horizon.pages.split_setup.tooltip: Prozori i monitori, i ko gde igra.
horizon.pages.shader_packs.tooltip: Paketi šejdera iz fascikle shaderpacks: OffHorizon-ovi i oni u formatu shaders/. Istovremeno radi samo jedan.
horizon.pages.mods.tooltip: Modovi napravljeni za OffHorizon, iz fascikle horizon-mods. Svaki radi u izolovanom okruženju i ostaje isključen dok ga ne uključite.

horizon.mods.switch.registries: adds blocks, items or other registry entries
horizon.mods.switch.restart: Restart the game to apply %s: they add blocks, items or world generation.
Horizon: light sources and the sun shine: OffHorizon: light sources and the sun shine past white. Vanilla: just as SDR.
This feature is not yet available in Hor: Ova funkcija još nije dostupna u OffHorizon-u.
Your display or system doesn't offer HDR: Vaš ekran ili sistem ne nude HDR izlaz.
Uključite HDR da biste ga koristili.
The shader pack lights the world. Pick i: The shader pack lights the world. Pick it under Shaders.
The shader pack's picture is shown at Pa: The shader pack's picture is shown at Paper White.
Your GPU or graphics API doesn't support: Vaš GPU ili grafički API to ne podržava.
Not with software rendering, which runs: Not with software rendering, which runs it on the CPU.
Out of video memory: off until the next: Out of video memory: off until the next start.
The graphics device was lost: off until: The graphics device was lost: off until the next start.
Not on DirectX 12 yet: try the Vulkan gr: Not on DirectX 12 yet: try the Vulkan graphics API.
Full-detail terrain range. LOD Distance: Opseg terena sa punim detaljima. LOD Udaljenost može proširiti lokalne svetove dalje.
Grubi udaljeni teren u lokalnim svetovima. Integrisani GPU-ovi se zaustavljaju na 128 komada.
Reduced draws far terrain coarser: faste: Smanjeno crtanje daleko grublje: brže na ovom integrisanom GPU-u.
Reduced draws far terrain coarser, for G: Smanjeno crtanje dalekog terena je grublje, za GPU usporava.
Caps frames per second; a cap saves powe: Caps broj frejmova u sekundi; kapa štedi energiju i toplotu.
Waits for the display's refresh: no tear: Čeka osvežavanje ekrana: nema kidanja, malo kašnjenja.
Sets the options below together. Changin: Zajedno postavlja opcije ispod. Promena jednog čini ga prilagođenim.
Lava, fire and the sun shine brighter th: Lava, fire and the sun shine brighter than white. Needs an HDR display.
Lifts shadows onto your display's darkes: Lifts shadows onto your display's darkest black. 0: true black, no lift.
How bright highlights get. Auto: the pea: Kako svetli naglasci dobijaju. Automatski: vrhunac koji vaš sistem izveštava.
How bright white looks in the world. Aut: How bright white looks in the world. Auto: your desktop's white.
How bright the HUD and menus are. Auto:: How bright the HUD and menus are. Auto: at paper white.
How far mobs, crops and machines keep wo: Dokle rulje, usevi i mašine nastavljaju da rade. CPU vreme.
How far away mobs and items are drawn, a: Koliko su udaljene rulje i predmeti, kao udeo normalnog.
Skips terrain hidden behind closed secti: Preskače teren skriven iza zatvorenih delova. Isključenje košta mnogo.
Culls nearby terrain on the GPU: less CP: Culls nearby terrain on the GPU: less CPU at high render distance, more GPU.
Auto: tries it where your CPU limits the: Auto: tries it where your CPU limits the frame, keeps it if frames get faster.
CPU test okluzije pokreće ovaj okvir.
Provere okluzije se pokreću na radnoj niti.
Meshed sections uploaded per frame. Lowe: Mrežasti delovi otpremljeni po kadru. Donji deo je glatkiji tokom učitavanja.
Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk bui: Meke senke u uglovima. Košta samo vreme izgradnje komada.
Smaller copies of block textures for dis: Manje kopije blok tekstura za udaljeni teren: manje svetlucanja.
Blends grass and water colours across bi: Kombinuje boje trave i vode u biomima prilikom izgradnje komada.
Crta nebo, sunce, mesec i zvezde.
Distance fog. Off shows the edge of the: Distance magla. Isključeno pokazuje ivicu učitanog sveta.
Koliko daleko pada kiša i sneg oko tebe.
Okrugle senke ispod rulja i predmeta.
Leaves with see-through gaps. Off draws: Listovi sa providnim prazninama. Off ih čvrsto privlači.
Sorts water and glass more exactly behin: Tačnije sortira vodu i staklo jedno iza drugog.
Which chunk rebuilds wait for the frame:: Koji deo rekonstruiše čeka na okvir: nijedan, u blizini ili tvoj.
Animates water, lava, fire and other mov: Animira vodu, lavu, vatru i druge pokretne teksture.
World pixels per screen pixel. Below 100: Svetski pikseli po pikselu ekrana. Ispod 100% je brži na GPU-u.
Raises Resolution Scale toward 100% whil: Raises Resolution Scale toward 100% while the frame rate allows it.
The frame rate Dynamic Resolution keeps.
Smooths jagged edges. FXAA: softer. TAA:: Zaglađuje nazubljene ivice. FKSAA: mekši. TAA: najglađe, pokretne stvari mogu da zaostaju.
Renders the world smaller and rebuilds i: Čini svet manjim i ponovo ga gradi pomoću TAA. Brže, mekše.
Sharpens the upscaled picture. Higher: c: Sharpens the upscaled picture. Higher: crisper edges, more shimmer.
How frames reach the screen while VSync: Kako okviri stižu do ekrana dok je VSinc isključen.
Efficient sleeps until the next frame; P: Efikasno spava do sledećeg kadra; Precizno okretanje, poput vanile.
Lowers the frame rate when minimised, or: Smanjuje brzinu kadrova kada je minimizirana ili u stanju mirovanja.
60 FPS cap (30 in menus or unfocused), h: Ograničenje od 60 FPS (30 u menijima ili nefokusirano), pola radnika: manje energije.
Threads that generate, light and mesh ch: Niti koje stvaraju, lagane i mrežaste komade. Sledeći početak.
Vulkan, then DirectX 12 (Windows) or Ope: Vulkan, zatim DirectX 12 (Windows) ili OpenGL (Linux) gde on ne radi. Pri sledećem pokretanju.
Water and glass in one buffer: fewer dra: Voda i staklo u jednom baferu: manje poziva za povlačenje, malo više VRAM-a. Sledeći početak.
Mesh data sent to the GPU per frame. Low: Mrežni podaci se šalju GPU-u po okviru. Donji deo je glatkiji tokom učitavanja.
Frame rate and frame times over the game: Brzina kadrova i vremena kadrova tokom igre, sa grafikonom.

Učitavanje komada, izbacivanje i korišćenje energije.

horizon.extras.wheel_cycles_list_setting: The scroll wheel over a button in a settings list changes its value. Off, as in vanilla, the wheel scrolls the list.
horizon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Prikažite blokove i entitete pri punom svetlu, čak i u tamnim oblastima.
horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Baklje i drugi izvori svetlosti koji su držani, ispušteni ili zapaljeni osvetljavaju blokove oko sebe.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Prikazuje vaše ime iznad glave u trećem licu, kako ga vide drugi igrači. Skriveno kada server sakriva imena vašeg tima ili ste nevidljivi.
horizon.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Sakriva čestice krhotina koje su eksplodirale iz slomljenog bloka i raspadale se sa onog koji ste kopali. Ostale čestice ostaju.
horizon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Ponovo se pridružuje serveru nakon izgubljene veze ili ponovnog pokretanja, nikada nakon izbacivanja ili zabrane.
horizon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Zvukovi u svetu ostavljaju slobodnim 16 od 247 zvučnih kanala, tako da njihova poplava (velika eksplozija) ne može da utiša klikove menija.
horizon.extras.music_page.tooltip: Muzika i zvuci dobijaju stranicu „Muzika...“: pustite bilo koju ugrađenu numeru sada ili je isključite da bi igra prestala da je bira. Ništa se ne menja dok ne isključite numeru.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Prevlačenjem udesno postavlja po jednu po utoru, prevlačenjem ulevo skuplja zadržanu stavku, Shift + prevlačenje ulevo pomera svaki slot.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Dole šalje jednu stavku utora na drugu stranu, gore vraća jednu nazad.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Sortira inventar, sanduke, burad, ender sanduke i kutije za šulkere u kreativnom redosledu kartica, spajajući gomile.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sortira deo ispod kursora. Kliknite, a zatim pritisnite taster; Escape ga odvezuje.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Sakriva i isključuje svaku AI funkciju: kontrolu agenta, horizon-ctl i MCP servere. Prekidač lansera takođe.
horizon.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Vaš sopstveni AI agent može da igra ovu igru preko horizon-ctl ili MCP klijenta, samo na ovom računaru.
horizon.extras.discord_presence.tooltip: Prikazuje „Igra OffHorizon“ na vašem Discord profilu dok Discord radi: meniji, jedan ili više igrača, dimenzija i vreme igranja. Nikada ime sveta ili adresu servera.
Sets the three below full screen, one te: Postavlja tri ispod celog ekrana, jednu po jednu probnu sliku.
Your display didn't say how bright it ge: Vaš ekran nije rekao koliko svetli: kalibrišite ga da biste ga podesili.
Auto uses the peak Windows reports. Cali: Auto uses the peak Windows reports. Calibrate if highlights look clipped.
Already set up for your display. Only ca: Već je podešeno za vaš ekran. Kalibrirajte samo ako HDR izgleda pogrešno.
Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White bac: Vraća Peak Brightness i Paper Vhite u podešavanja vašeg ekrana.
Set up for your display. Leave on Auto u: Podesite za svoj ekran. Ostavite na Auto osim ako ne izgleda pogrešno.
HDR output stopped the game the last tim: HDR output stopped the game the last time it started with this graphics driver. Choose a mode to try again.
Lower it until the logo just disappears: Spustite ga dok logo ne nestane u crno.
Raise it until the logo just disappears: Podignite ga dok logo ne nestane u svetlom kvadratu.
Make the card a white that's comfortable: Neka karta bude bela koja je udobna za gledanje dugo vremena, na svetlu u kojem igrate.

Fullscreen takes the display over, at th: Fullscreen takes the display over, at the mode below.

How much speed, sprinting and status eff: How much speed, sprinting and status effects change the field of view.
How textures are sampled: sharper at a s: How textures are sampled: sharper at a slant with Anisotropic.
How far Anisotropic filtering goes. High: How far Anisotropic filtering goes. Higher is sharper at a slant.
Picks a shader pack, Horizon's or a shad: Picks a shader pack, OffHorizon's or a shaders/ folder one, and sets its options.
Reuses the pack shadow map when sun, vie: Ponovo koristi mapu senki paketa kada se poklope sunce, pogled i svet. Podrazumevano isključeno.
On servers, finds their BlueMap web map: Na serverima pronalazi njihovu BlueMap veb mapu za daleki teren. Sledeće pridruživanje.
How far around you BlueMap tiles are dow: Koliko daleko oko vas se preuzimaju BlueMap pločice. Sledeće pridruživanje.
Drops leaf faces behind two leaf layers:: Drops leaf faces behind two leaf layers: faster, same crowns.
Leaves fully inside a canopy draw solid:: Listovi u potpunosti unutar krošnje crtaju čvrsto: manje providnih slojeva.
Leaves with one open side draw solid too: Listovi sa jednom otvorenom stranom takođe crtaju čvrsto: brže, krupnije ivice.
Drops faces between leaves: faster, but: Pada lica između listova: brže, ali praznine gledaju kroz njih.

horizon.pack.options.title: Pack Options
horizon.extras.cosmetics_mine.tooltip: Skriveno: svaki OffHorizon igrač vas vidi bez kozmetike, uključujući i vas. Isti prekidač kao Garderoba u pokretaču.
horizon.emote_wheel.title: Emotes
horizon.emote_wheel.help: Release or click to play · 1–8 · Esc closes
horizon.extras.cosmetics_others.tooltip: Šta nose drugi OffHorizon igrači: sve, samo stilove oznaka imena ili ništa. Kada je skriveno, igra nikada ne pita šta nose.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_hide_fx: Sakrij tragove i aure drugih igrača
horizon.extras.cosmetics_hide_fx.tooltip: Tragovi i aure drugih igrača ostaju skriveni; njihova ostala kozmetika se i dalje vidi. Isključeno po zadanom.
horizon.tempban.dedicated_required: Temporary bans need a dedicated server
horizon.extras.cosmetics_solo.tooltip: Show your cosmetics and your name tag's badge in your single-player worlds too (your name tag with Own name tag). Off: only on servers.
horizon.extras.horizon_marks.tooltip: Show the OffHorizon logo next to OffHorizon players: a small logo before the names of other players who use OffHorizon, above their heads and in the player list. Only OffHorizon players see it: servers receive nothing.
horizon.extras.horizon_me.tooltip: Show me as a OffHorizon player: other OffHorizon players see the logo by your name. On, the service answers anyone who asks about you that you played OffHorizon in the last 3 hours; off, it never reports you.
horizon.pages.pvp.tooltip: Crosshair, HUD and PvP settings, all off by default. Nothing here shows what vanilla doesn't.
horizon.pvp.crosshair.tooltip: Draws your own crosshair instead of vanilla's. Its first settings look like vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_shape.tooltip: A cross, a T, an X, a circle, a square or only a dot.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_size.tooltip: The length of each arm, in GUI pixels.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_gap.tooltip: The empty space in the middle.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_colour.tooltip: Inverted shows the colour under it inverted, as vanilla's crosshair does.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_outline.tooltip: A thin black edge, so it shows on any background.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_dot.tooltip: A dot in the middle of the crosshair.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_hover.tooltip: Another colour while the crosshair is over a mob or a player you could hit, as vanilla's attack indicator knows it.
horizon.pvp.outline.tooltip: Changes the outline around the block you look at.
horizon.pvp.outline_colour.tooltip: The outline's colour. Black at 40% is vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.outline_thickness.tooltip: The outline's width, in times vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.outline_fill.tooltip: Tints the faces of the block you look at, lightly.
horizon.pvp.hit.tooltip: Changes the colour mobs and players flash when they are hurt. Red at 30% is vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.hit_colour.tooltip: The colour hurt mobs and players flash.
horizon.pvp.hit_opacity.tooltip: How much of the colour covers them.
horizon.pvp.hud_armour.tooltip: The armour you wear, head first, with how many uses each piece has left.
horizon.pvp.hud_armour_percent.tooltip: Uses left as a percent of the piece's maximum instead of a number.
horizon.pvp.hud_effects.tooltip: Your effects with their names, levels and time left, in place of the icons at the top right.
horizon.pvp.hud_held.tooltip: How many of the item in your hand your inventory holds; arrows with a bow or crossbow.
horizon.pvp.hud_background.tooltip: A dark box behind each widget.
horizon.pvp.hud_opacity.tooltip: How dark the boxes behind the widgets are.
horizon.pvp.hud_text_colour.tooltip: The widgets' text colour. Durability keeps its green to red.
horizon.pvp.hud_shadow.tooltip: A shadow under the widgets' text, as vanilla's HUD text has.
horizon.pvp.hud_ping.tooltip: The latency the server reports for you, in milliseconds. Multiplayer only.
horizon.pvp.hud_coords.tooltip: Your block position and the direction you face, as F3 shows them. Hidden when the world or server reduces F3.
horizon.pvp.hud_server.tooltip: The address of the server you play on. Multiplayer only.
horizon.pvp.hud_combo.tooltip: Hits in a row the server confirmed, until you are hurt or 3 seconds pass without one.
horizon.pvp.hud_fps.tooltip: Frames drawn in the last second.
horizon.pvp.hud_cps.tooltip: Your left and right clicks in the last second.
horizon.pvp.hud_cps_corner.tooltip: Where the clicks per second show.
horizon.pvp.hud_keys.tooltip: Your movement keys, mouse buttons and jump, lit while you hold them, with clicks per second.
horizon.pvp.hud_reach.tooltip: How far from your eyes your last hit landed, for 3 seconds. It only measures: your reach stays vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.hud_speed.tooltip: How fast you move across the ground, in blocks per second.
horizon.pvp.numeric_enchants.tooltip: Tooltips and the enchanting table show Sharpness 5 instead of Sharpness V.
horizon.pvp.fire_lower.tooltip: Moves the flames you see while burning down, so they cover less of the screen.
horizon.pvp.shield_size.tooltip: The size of the shield in your hand, in first person.
horizon.pvp.totem_size.tooltip: The size of the totem that fills the screen when it saves you.
horizon.pvp.glint_colour.tooltip: The colour of the shimmer on enchanted items and armour. Off is vanilla's purple.
horizon.pvp.clear_water.tooltip: Under water, see as far as vanilla lets you after 30 seconds there, from the start.
horizon.pvp.clear_lava.tooltip: In lava, see as far as vanilla's Fire Resistance lets you, without the effect.
horizon.pvp.view_time.tooltip: The time of day you see: the sky and its light only. The world's time goes on and nothing is sent to the server.
horizon.pvp.view_weather.tooltip: The weather you see: rain, its light and fog only. The world's weather goes on and nothing is sent to the server.
horizon.pvp.chat_timestamps.tooltip: The time each message came in, before it.
horizon.pvp.chat_compact.tooltip: A message repeated in a row shows once, with how many times it came: (x3).
horizon.pvp.chat_copy.tooltip: Clicking a message in the open chat copies its text, unless the click does something else.
horizon.pvp.chat_search.tooltip: Ctrl+F in the open chat: what you type shows only the messages holding it. Enter or Ctrl+F again stops.
horizon.pvp.preset.tooltip: Turns on the custom crosshair, the armour and effects widgets, toggle sprint and sneak, lower fire, and the FPS counter and keystrokes mods if installed. Your settings for each stay.
horizon.pvp.hud_editor_key.tooltip: Opens the HUD editor from the game. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
horizon.pvp.editor.tooltip: Move the widgets on the game: drag them anywhere, resize them with the wheel, right click one to put it back in its corner.
horizon.pvp.editor.hint: Drag widgets · Wheel: size · Right click: back to its corner
horizon.pvp.combat_feel.tooltip: Legacy draws fights as 1.8.9 did: the item in your hand, its swing, eating, the bow and a sword held up while you hold use, without the dip after each hit or the attack indicator. Only the look: what you send a server stays the same.
horizon.pvp.combat_indicator.tooltip: Keeps the attack indicator under Legacy, which 1.8.9 didn't have.
horizon.pvp.combat_sounds.tooltip: Under Legacy, leaves out the attack sounds 1.9 added (strong, weak, sweep, critical...). Hurt sounds stay.
horizon.pvp.combat_rules.tooltip: Single player and the worlds you open to LAN fight by 1.8.9's rules: no attack cooldown or sweep, 1.8 weapon damage, Strength, Sharpness and critical hits. Servers you join keep their own rules.

How far the left stick moves before you: How far the left stick moves before you walk. Raise it if you drift.
How far a trigger is pulled before it co: How far a trigger is pulled before it counts as pressed.
Shows what your buttons do right now, in: Shows what your buttons do right now, in play and in inventories.
Shows only what you can do with what you: Shows only what you can do with what you're looking at, and the main inventory buttons.
Doesn't show what your buttons do.
Shows the buttons of the controller you': Shows the buttons of the controller you're using.
A, on the right, confirms and jumps and: A, on the right, confirms and jumps and B goes back, as on a Switch.
B, at the bottom, confirms and jumps and: B, at the bottom, confirms and jumps and A goes back, as on other controllers.
Opens Steam's keyboard on a Steam Deck u: Opens Steam's keyboard on a Steam Deck under Steam, and OffHorizon's otherwise.
A DualSense's light shows your health, f: A DualSense's light shows your health, from green through amber to red.
A DualSense's light changes with the dim: A DualSense's light changes with the dimension you're in.
A DualSense keeps its own light.
Lets LT + A craft on servers other than: Lets LT + A craft on servers other than your own worlds. Some servers count it as a macro.
Show the buttons for what you can do, wh: Show the buttons for what you can do, while you play with a controller.
How fast the stick moves the crosshair i: How fast the stick moves the crosshair in inventories.
How fast the right stick scrolls a list.
How long a held direction waits before i: How long a held direction waits before it repeats.
How long a held direction takes between: How long a held direction takes between repeats.
Which on-screen keyboard opens when a te: Which on-screen keyboard opens when a text field is pressed.
Every action back on its default button.
These settings belong to this player's p: These settings belong to this player's profile.
The controller driving this player, or e: The controller driving this player, or else the first one connected.
The USB vendor and product the system re: The USB vendor and product the system reports. Useful when reporting a controller that misbehaves.
The glyph family the game picked from th: The glyph family the game picked from the controller's maker.
Follow the controller, or always show on: Follow the controller, or always show one family's buttons.
Whether a Nintendo controller's A and B: Whether a Nintendo controller's A and B work by where they sit or by their letters.
The buttons menus show right now.
Rumble when something happens to you.
A tick when you break a block, as in Bed: A tick when you break a block, as in Bedrock.
A short buzz when you split a stack, as: A short buzz when you split a stack, as in Bedrock.
An Xbox One controller's triggers buzz w: An Xbox One controller's triggers buzz with its handles.
The controller keeps playing while this: The controller keeps playing while this window isn't focused, and losing focus won't pause.
A DualSense's triggers push back on bows: A DualSense's triggers push back on bows and tools.
What a DualSense's light shows, over USB: What a DualSense's light shows, over USB or Bluetooth.
Press the button for this. %s cancels.
Not bound: press this row, then the butt: Not bound: press this row, then the button that should do it.
